checks.name: Actual observed Google query keys state/iss/code/scope reach fixed workspace handoff without consuming or dispatching
Legacy callback with no issuer remains compatible and retains the same grant
Issuer comparison rejects normalization/confusable/userinfo/encoded-extra mismatches before state lookup
Duplicate issuers including percent-encoded key aliases fail closed; a single encoded exact issuer is accepted
Existing core duplicate, mixed code/denial and unknown query rejections survive issuer support
Issuer is enforced even with unknown/missing state; valid issuer never substitutes for pending state
Same owner mailbox in a different session still cannot complete an issuer-bearing grant
Original signed-in owner completes callback once through actual client handler and PKCE-bound synthetic exchange
Completed issuer callback and owner completion replay cannot exchange or dispatch a second time
Issuer-bearing access denial uses fixed denial fragment and consumes only original owner grant without token exchange
Callback issuer does not accept foreign tenant identity or an expired authorization
Mutation method and retired permanent-owner-key entry remain rejected without effects
